notes: The Firefox 159.0 patch series in patches/ was generated against this exact tag and verified with `git apply --check`.

source_sha512 is intentionally null: fetch-source.sh downloads Mozilla's signed SHA512SUMS for the pinned version and verifies the tarball against it, so the hash always matches the archive actually served (mirrors rotate old builds).
Set SHEEPFOX_EXPECTED_SHA512 to pin a literal digest in air-gapped or mirrored builds.
Set SHEEPFOX_MIRROR to point at an internal mirror that keeps the same /releases/<version>/... layout.
When Mozilla ships a security point release, bump version + tag together and re-verify the patch series with `make patch-source`.
